newsitem.title: UK: LME copper maintains firmness into evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper maintains firmness into evening session.

text.p: London Metal Exchange copper prices maintained the day's firm trend during evening inter-office trading which helped underpin aluminium prices.
Traders attributed copper's strength to a combination of firmer Comex, constructive technical indicators and market talk that LME copper stocks may be unchanged to slightly lower on Friday.

Also, looking past the forthcoming holiday period, the traditional wave of early new-year friendliness to the metals markets could be accompanied by a build-up of supply tightness around the middle of January, which has widened the cash/threes backwardation recently.
Traders said that this would discourage any significant build-up of short selling into the market and possibly exaggerate upside moves.
Three months delivery copper at 1900 GMT was quoted at $2,162/$2,165 a tonne against $2,155/$2,156 at the end of the afternoon kerb.
Aluminium rose to $1,552/1,554 from $1,546.5/1,547 a tonne.
